I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the hub replacement for Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092.

That number comes from Ilse's message in #north-random on Oct 13, which said IT has that ticket open to replace the hub in that room. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so the number was safe to post there. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

Earlier, Dana sent me a private guess about a different ticket number. That's separate from #4092, so I didn't mention it in the channel.
